ContentInformationType

ContentType
required
string
Enum: "id-envelopedData" "id-ct-authData" "id-digestedData" "id-data"

Identifies the type of CMS protection applied to the content.

object (EnvelopedData)

CMS EnvelopedData — protects sensitive data (e.g. card data) by encryption using a session key transported by a KEK.

object (AuthenticatedData)

CMS AuthenticatedData — protects the whole message (header and body) with a Retail CBC-MAC using SHA-256.

object (DigestedData)

CMS DigestedData — used for integrity protection via a digest of the content.

KEKIdentifier

KeyIdentifier
required
string

Name of the KEK. Contains the suffix 'MACKey' for MAC keys or 'DATKey' for data encryption keys.

KeyVersion
string

Version of the KEK, typically representing the key creation date.

ISOCurrency3A

string (ISOCurrency3A) = 3 characters

Currency identification per ISO 4217 — three contiguous capital letters (e.g. EUR, USD).

"str"

ISOCountry3A

string (ISOCountry3A) = 3 characters

Country code per ISO 3166-1 — three alpha characters (e.g. FRA, GBR).

"str"

ISOLanguage2A

string (ISOLanguage2A) = 2 characters

Language identification per ISO 639-1 — two alpha characters (e.g. en, fr, de).

"st"

ISODateTime

string (ISODateTime)

Date and time per ISO 8601 / W3C XML Schema dateTime in the form yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss[.sss]±HH:mm. Time zone is mandatory. Example: 2015-03-08T09:13:51.0+01:00.

"string"

ISODate

string (ISODate)

Date per ISO 8601 in the form yyyy-MM-dd. Example: 2015-03-08.

"string"

ProtocolVersion

string (ProtocolVersion) ^\d+\.\d+$

Version of the Sale to POI protocol specifications. Format is MM.mm (major.minor). For this version of the specification the value is '3.0'.

"string"

SimpleAmountType

number (SimpleAmountType) >= 0

Unsigned decimal amount without an implied currency. Maximum 8 digits before the decimal point and 6 digits after. The decimal point and fractional part are optional when zero. Leading and trailing zeros should be removed (e.g. 320 not 00320.00, 56.1 not 56.10).

0

MessageClassType

string (MessageClassType)
Enum: "Service" "Device" "Event"

Class of message: Service (transaction request/response initiated by Sale), Device (device operation), or Event (unsolicited notification from POI).

"Service"

MessageCategoryType

string (MessageCategoryType)
Enum: "Abort" "Admin" "BalanceInquiry" "Batch" "CardAcquisition" "CardReaderAPDU" "CardReaderInit" "CardReaderPowerOff" "Diagnosis" "Display" "EnableService" "Event" "GetTotals" "Input" "InputUpdate" "Login" "Logout" "Loyalty" "Payment" "PIN" "Print" "Reconciliation" "Reversal" "Sound" "StoredValue" "TransactionStatus" "Transmit"

Category of message identifying the type of service or operation being requested or responded to.

"Abort"

MessageTypeType

string (MessageTypeType)
Enum: "Request" "Response" "Notification"

Type of message: Request (requires a response), Response (answers a request), or Notification (unsolicited, no response required).

"Request"

ResultType

string (ResultType)
Enum: "Success" "Failure" "Partial"

Global result of the processing of a message request: Success, Failure, or Partial (e.g. only partial amount authorised).

"Success"

ErrorConditionType

string (ErrorConditionType)
Enum: "Aborted" "Busy" "Cancel" "DeviceOut" "InsertedCard" "InProgress" "LoggedOut" "MessageFormat" "NotAllowed" "NotFound" "PaymentRestriction" "Refusal" "UnavailableDevice" "UnavailableService" "InvalidCard" "UnreachableHost" "WrongPIN"

Condition that produced a failure, allowing the requestor to determine the appropriate resolution action.

"Aborted"

TerminalEnvironmentType

string (TerminalEnvironmentType)
Enum: "Attended" "SemiAttended" "Unattended"

Environment of the terminal: Attended (cashier present), SemiAttended (customer self-service with optional cashier assistance), or Unattended (fully automated).

"Attended"

GenericProfileType

string (GenericProfileType)
Enum: "Basic" "Standard" "Extended"

Functional profile of the Sale to POI protocol indicating the group of messages implemented: Basic (minimum), Standard (adds device sharing), or Extended (complete interface).

"Basic"

PaymentInstrumentTypeEnum

string (PaymentInstrumentTypeEnum)
Enum: "Card" "Check" "Mobile" "StoredValue" "Cash"

Type of payment instrument used for the transaction.

"Card"

PaymentTypeEnum

string (PaymentTypeEnum)
Enum: "Normal" "Refund" "OneTimeReservation" "FirstReservation" "UpdateReservation" "Completion" "CashAdvance" "CashDeposit" "Recurring" "Instalment" "IssuerInstalment" "PaidOut"

Type of payment transaction identifying the specific payment service requested.

"Normal"

LoyaltyTransactionTypeEnum

string (LoyaltyTransactionTypeEnum)
Enum: "Award" "Rebate" "Redemption" "AwardRefund" "RebateRefund" "RedemptionRefund"

Type of loyalty transaction: award, rebate, redemption, or their respective refunds.

"Award"

LoyaltyHandlingEnum

string (LoyaltyHandlingEnum)
Enum: "Forbidden" "Processed" "Allowed" "Proposed" "Required"

Type of loyalty processing requested by the Sale System: Forbidden (no loyalty), Processed (already done), Allowed (optional), Proposed (POI asks customer), or Required (mandatory).

"Forbidden"

LoyaltyUnitEnum

string (LoyaltyUnitEnum)
Enum: "Point" "Monetary"

Unit of a loyalty amount: Point (numeric points) or Monetary (amount in a currency).

"Point"

StoredValueAccountTypeEnum

string (StoredValueAccountTypeEnum)
Enum: "GiftCard" "PhoneCard" "Other"

Type of stored value account instrument: GiftCard, PhoneCard, or Other.

"GiftCard"

StoredValueTransactionTypeEnum

string (StoredValueTransactionTypeEnum)
Enum: "Reserve" "Activate" "Load" "Unload" "Reverse" "Duplicate"

Type of operation to perform on a stored value account: Reserve, Activate, Load, Unload, Reverse, or Duplicate.

"Reserve"

IdentificationTypeEnum

string (IdentificationTypeEnum)
Enum: "PAN" "ISOTrack2" "BarCode" "AccountNumber" "PhoneNumber"

Type of account identification used for loyalty or stored value: PAN, ISOTrack2, BarCode, AccountNumber, or PhoneNumber.

"PAN"

IdentificationSupportEnum

string (IdentificationSupportEnum)
Enum: "NoCard" "LoyaltyCard" "HybridCard" "LinkedCard"

Support medium of the loyalty account identification: NoCard (not on a card), LoyaltyCard (dedicated loyalty card), HybridCard (combined payment/loyalty), or LinkedCard (implicitly linked to payment card).

"NoCard"

DeviceEnum

string (DeviceEnum)
Enum: "CashierDisplay" "CustomerDisplay" "CashierInput" "CustomerInput"

Logical device on a Sale or POI Terminal: CashierDisplay, CustomerDisplay, CashierInput, or CustomerInput.

"CashierDisplay"

InfoQualifyEnum

string (InfoQualifyEnum)
Enum: "Status" "Error" "Display" "Sound" "Input" "POIReplication" "CustomerAssistance" "Receipt" "Document" "Voucher"

Qualification of information sent to an output device: Status (state change), Error (error situation), Display (standard display), Sound, Input (entry requested), POIReplication (mirror of POI customer display), CustomerAssistance (cashier assisting customer), Receipt, Document, or Voucher.

"Status"

OutputFormatEnum

string (OutputFormatEnum)
Enum: "MessageRef" "Text" "XHTML" "BarCode"

Format of the content to display or print: MessageRef (predefined message), Text (formatted text), XHTML (XHTML document), or BarCode.

"MessageRef"

InputCommandEnum

string (InputCommandEnum)
Enum: "GetAnyKey" "GetConfirmation" "SiteManager" "TextString" "DigitString" "DecimalString" "GetFunctionKey" "GetMenuEntry" "Password"

Type of input requested from the user: GetAnyKey (read confirmation), GetConfirmation (yes/no), SiteManager (site manager confirmation), TextString, DigitString, DecimalString, GetFunctionKey, GetMenuEntry, or Password.

"GetAnyKey"

MenuEntryTagEnum

string (MenuEntryTagEnum)
Enum: "Selectable" "NonSelectable" "SubMenu" "NonSelectableSubMenu"

Characteristics of a menu entry: Selectable, NonSelectable, SubMenu (selection shows sub-menu), or NonSelectableSubMenu.

"Selectable"

AlignmentEnum

string (AlignmentEnum)
Enum: "Left" "Right" "Centred" "Justified"

Alignment of the text string on the display or print line.

"Left"

CharacterHeightEnum

string (CharacterHeightEnum)
Enum: "SingleHeight" "DoubleHeight" "HalfHeight"

Character height of the text string to display or print.

"SingleHeight"

CharacterWidthEnum

string (CharacterWidthEnum)
Enum: "SingleWidth" "DoubleWidth"

Character width of the text string to display or print.

"SingleWidth"

CharacterStyleEnum

string (CharacterStyleEnum)
Enum: "Normal" "Bold" "Italic" "Underlined"

Typographic style of the text to display or print.

"Normal"

ColorEnum

string (ColorEnum)

"White"

MessageHeader

ProtocolVersion
string (ProtocolVersion) ^\d+\.\d+$

Version of the Sale to POI protocol specifications. Format is MM.mm (major.minor). For this version of the specification the value is '3.0'.

MessageClass
required
string (MessageClassType)
Enum: "Service" "Device" "Event"

Class of message: Service (transaction request/response initiated by Sale), Device (device operation), or Event (unsolicited notification from POI).

MessageCategory
required
string (MessageCategoryType)
Enum: "Abort" "Admin" "BalanceInquiry" "Batch" "CardAcquisition" "CardReaderAPDU" "CardReaderInit" "CardReaderPowerOff" "Diagnosis" "Display" "EnableService" "Event" "GetTotals" "Input" "InputUpdate" "Login" "Logout" "Loyalty" "Payment" "PIN" "Print" "Reconciliation" "Reversal" "Sound" "StoredValue" "TransactionStatus" "Transmit"

MessageType
required
string (MessageTypeType)
Enum: "Request" "Response" "Notification"

Type of message: Request (requires a response), Response (answers a request), or Notification (unsolicited, no response required).

ServiceID
string <= 10 characters

Unique identification of a Service or Event message pair between a Sale and POI component. Mandatory for Service and Event class messages.

DeviceID
string <= 10 characters

Unique identification of a Device message pair. Mandatory for Device class messages.

SaleID
required
string

Hierarchical identification of the Sale System or Sale Terminal. Its scope is limited to the Sale to POI protocol.

POIID
required
string

Hierarchical identification of the POI System or POI Terminal. Its scope is limited to the Sale to POI protocol.

TransactionConditions

AllowedPaymentBrand
Array of strings

Payment card brands allowed for this transaction. Restricts the brand if present.

AcquirerID
Array of strings

Preferred Acquirers for this transaction. The POI must use one of these if present.

DebitPreferredFlag
boolean

When true, a debit transaction is preferred over a credit transaction. Default false.

AllowedLoyaltyBrand
Array of strings

Loyalty brands allowed for this transaction. Restricts the loyalty brand if present.

LoyaltyHandling
string (LoyaltyHandlingEnum)
Enum: "Forbidden" "Processed" "Allowed" "Proposed" "Required"

Type of loyalty processing requested by the Sale System: Forbidden (no loyalty), Processed (already done), Allowed (optional), Proposed (POI asks customer), or Required (mandatory).

CustomerLanguage
string (ISOLanguage2A) = 2 characters

Language identification per ISO 639-1 — two alpha characters (e.g. en, fr, de).

ForceOnlineFlag
boolean

When true, forces the POI to go online for authorisation regardless of card rules. Default false.

ForceEntryMode
Array of strings (ForceEntryModeType)
Items Enum: "RFID" "Keyed" "Manual" "File" "Scanned" "MagStripe" "ICC" "SynchronousICC" "Tapped" "Contactless" "CheckReader"

Restricts which card reader entry modes the POI may use for this transaction. Useful to avoid retry on a known out-of-order device. The order of values gives priority among modes.

MerchantCategoryCode
string

ISO 18245 Merchant Category Code when the Sale Terminal has multiple MCCs for different goods/services.

integer

string (ISOLanguage2A) = 2 characters

Language identification per ISO 639-1 — two alpha characters (e.g. en, fr, de).

ForceEntryMode
Array of strings (ForceEntryModeType)
Items Enum: "RFID" "Keyed" "Manual" "File" "Scanned" "MagStripe" "ICC" "SynchronousICC" "Tapped" "Contactless" "CheckReader"

Restricts which card reader entry modes the POI may use for this transaction. Useful to avoid retry on a known out-of-order device. The order of values gives priority among modes.

ForceCustomerSelectionFlag
boolean

When true, the customer must select the card application on a multi-application smartcard. Default false.

TotalAmount
number (SimpleAmountType) >= 0

Type of payment transaction identifying the specific payment service requested.

Enum: "CashierDisplay" "CustomerDisplay" "CashierInput" "CustomerInput"

Logical device on a Sale or POI Terminal: CashierDisplay, CustomerDisplay, CashierInput, or CustomerInput.

InfoQualify
required
string (InfoQualifyEnum)
Enum: "Status" "Error" "Display" "Sound" "Input" "POIReplication" "CustomerAssistance" "Receipt" "Document" "Voucher"

Qualification of information sent to an output device: Status (state change), Error (error situation), Display (standard display), Sound, Input (entry requested), POIReplication (mirror of POI customer display), CustomerAssistance (cashier assisting customer), Receipt, Document, or Voucher.

InputCommand
required
string (InputCommandEnum)
Enum: "GetAnyKey" "GetConfirmation" "SiteManager" "TextString" "DigitString" "DecimalString" "GetFunctionKey" "GetMenuEntry" "Password"

Type of input requested from the user: GetAnyKey (read confirmation), GetConfirmation (yes/no), SiteManager (site manager confirmation), TextString, DigitString, DecimalString, GetFunctionKey, GetMenuEntry, or Password.

NotifyCardInputFlag
boolean

When true, the POI sends an InsertedCard error response if the customer inserts a card instead of completing the input. Default false.

MaxInputTime
integer

Maximum time in seconds to wait for the user to complete the input before automatic cancellation.

ImmediateResponseFlag
boolean

For GetAnyKey: when true, response is sent immediately without waiting for user confirmation. Default true.

MinLength
integer

Minimum length of the entered string, or minimum number of menu entries to select.

MaxLength
integer

Maximum length of the entered string, or maximum number of menu entries to select.

MaxDecimalLength
integer

Maximum number of digits after the decimal point for DecimalString input. Must be between MinLength and MaxLength.

WaitUserValidationFlag
boolean

When true, waits for user confirmation even after reaching MaxLength, allowing corrections. Default false.

DefaultInputString
string

Default string pre-filled in the input field. For GetConfirmation: 'Y' or 'N'.

StringMask
string

Format mask for the input. Characters: 'd' (digit), 'a' (alpha), 's' (other printable), any other char displayed but not entered, '' escapes d/a/s/.

FromRightToLeftFlag
boolean

When true, entered characters are displayed right-to-left (e.g. for amount entry). Default false.

MaskCharactersFlag
boolean

When true, entered characters are masked (replaced by '•') in the display. Default false.

BeepKeyFlag
boolean

When true, a beep is generated each time the user presses a key. Default false.

GlobalCorrectionFlag
boolean

When true, pressing Correct clears all entered characters; when false, only the last character is removed. Default false.

DisableCancelFlag
boolean

When true, the Cancel function key is disabled and not shown. Default false.

DisableCorrectFlag
boolean

When true, the Correct function key is disabled and not shown. Default false.

DisableValidFlag
boolean

When true, the Valid function key is disabled and not shown. Default false.

MenuBackFlag
boolean

For GetMenuEntry: when true, enables Back (returns -1) and Home (returns 0) navigation keys. Default false.

ResponseMode
required
string (ResponseModeEnum)
Enum: "NotRequired" "Immediate" "PrintEnd" "SoundEnd"

When the initiator expects a response: NotRequired (no response needed), Immediate (acknowledge receipt), PrintEnd (after printing complete), or SoundEnd (after sound complete).

IntegratedPrintFlag
boolean

When true, this print is integrated into another receipt rather than printed separately. Forces Immediate response mode. Default false.

RequiredSignatureFlag
boolean

When true, a physical cardholder signature is required on this printed document. Default false.

LoginRequest

DateTime
required
string (ISODateTime)

Date and time per ISO 8601 / W3C XML Schema dateTime in the form yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss[.sss]±HH:mm. Time zone is mandatory. Example: 2015-03-08T09:13:51.0+01:00.

required
object (SaleSoftware)

Information identifying the Sale System software product that manages the Sale to POI protocol.

object (SaleTerminalData)

Information about the Sale Terminal software and hardware characteristics, sent in Login and updated in subsequent messages when devices change.

TrainingModeFlag
boolean

When true, the entire session is for training/testing and no real transactions are processed. Default false.

OperatorLanguage
required
string (ISOLanguage2A) = 2 characters

Language identification per ISO 639-1 — two alpha characters (e.g. en, fr, de).

OperatorID
string

Identification of the Cashier driving the Sale Terminal. Sent for logging, reconciliation, or acquirer requirements.

ShiftNumber
string

Shift number for the session. Sent for logging and reconciliation purposes.

TokenRequestedType
string (TokenRequestedTypeEnum)
Enum: "Transaction" "Customer"

Type of payment token requested to replace the PAN: Transaction (valid for one transaction) or Customer (valid for a longer period to identify the customer).

CustomerOrderReq
Array of strings (CustomerOrderReqType)
Items Enum: "Open" "Closed" "Both"

Specifies which customer orders the POI should include in a response: Open orders, Closed orders, or Both.

POISerialNumber
string

Serial number of the POI Terminal as received in the last Login Response, to detect hardware changes.

EnableServiceRequest

TransactionAction
required
string (TransactionActionEnum)
Enum: "StartTransaction" "AbortTransaction"

Action to perform on a transaction via EnableService: StartTransaction (enable swipe-ahead) or AbortTransaction (cancel a started swipe-ahead or CardAcquisition).

ServicesEnabled
Array of strings (ServicesEnabledType)
Items Enum: "CardAcquisition" "Payment" "Loyalty"

Financial services enabled by an EnableService request, allowing the POI to start one of these services via the swipe-ahead mechanism before the Sale System sends the corresponding service request.

object (DisplayOutput)

A complete display operation for a logical device, including the content to display and processing parameters.

ReversalRequest

object (SaleData)

Data associated with the Sale System context for a transaction, including transaction identification and terminal characteristics.

SaleReferenceID
string

Sale reference identifying the reservation transaction to cancel. Mandatory for reservation reversals.

required
object (OriginalPOITransaction)

Reference to a previous POI transaction, used for reversals, completions, refunds, or to reuse card data from a prior transaction.

ReversalReason
required
string (ReversalReasonEnum)
Enum: "CustCancel" "MerchantCancel" "Malfunction" "Unable2Compl"

Reason for reversing a payment or loyalty transaction.

ReversedAmount
number (SimpleAmountType) >= 0

Unsigned decimal amount without an implied currency. Maximum 8 digits before the decimal point and 6 digits after. The decimal point and fractional part are optional when zero. Leading and trailing zeros should be removed (e.g. 320 not 00320.00, 56.1 not 56.10).

object (CustomerOrder)

Customer order recorded in the POI System, used for multi-step or multi-channel sale transactions such as click-and-collect.

ReconciliationRequest

ReconciliationType
required
string (ReconciliationTypeEnum)
Enum: "SaleReconciliation" "AcquirerSynchronisation" "AcquirerReconciliation" "PreviousReconciliation"

Type of reconciliation: SaleReconciliation (close current period without acquirer sync), AcquirerSynchronisation (close with acquirer sync), AcquirerReconciliation (acquirer only), or PreviousReconciliation (result of a previous period).

AcquirerID
Array of strings

Acquirers to include in AcquirerReconciliation or AcquirerSynchronisation. All connected Acquirers are included when absent.

POIReconciliationID
string

Identification of a previous reconciliation period. Mandatory for PreviousReconciliation type.

PINRequest

PINRequestType
required
string (PINRequestTypeEnum)
Enum: "PINVerify" "PINVerifyOnly" "PINEnter"

Type of PIN service requested: PINVerify (enter and verify), PINVerifyOnly (verify a pre-entered PIN block), or PINEnter (enter and encrypt only).

PINVerifMethod
string

Identifies the PIN verification method and keys. Optional for PINVerify and PINVerifyOnly.

AdditionalInput
string

Additional data required for PIN verification (e.g. part of PAN for ISO format 0). Optional for PINEnter and PINVerify.

PINEncAlgorithm
string

Identifies the PIN block encryption algorithm. Optional for PINEnter.

PINFormat
string (PINFormatEnum)
Enum: "ISO0" "ISO1" "ISO2" "ISO3"

Format of the PIN block before encryption, per ISO 9564.

KeyReference
string

Identifies the key to use to encrypt the PIN block. Optional for PINEnter.

MaxWaitingTime
integer

Maximum time in seconds to wait for PIN entry. Optional for PINEnter.

BeepKeyFlag
boolean

When true, a beep is generated for each key pressed during PIN entry. Default false.

object (CardholderPIN)

Encrypted PIN block and related information, used for PIN entry and verification services.

Restricts which card reader entry modes the POI may use for this transaction. Useful to avoid retry on a known out-of-order device. The order of values gives priority among modes.

LeaveCardFlag
boolean

When true, keeps the card in the reader after magnetic stripe reading to allow subsequent chip dialogue. Default true.

MaxWaitingTime
integer

Maximum time in seconds to wait for the card to be inserted.

APDUPar1
required
string

Parameter 1 field (P1) of the APDU command per ISO 7816-4. Base64-encoded 1 byte.

APDUPar2
required
string

Parameter 2 field (P2) of the APDU command per ISO 7816-4. Base64-encoded 1 byte.

APDUData
string

Data field (Lc + Data) of the APDU command. Mandatory when the instruction requires data.

APDUExpectedLength
string

Expected length (Le) of the data in the APDU response. Base64-encoded 1 byte. Absent means maximum available bytes are requested.

EventNotification

TimeStamp
required
string (ISODateTime)

Date and time per ISO 8601 / W3C XML Schema dateTime in the form yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss[.sss]±HH:mm. Time zone is mandatory. Example: 2015-03-08T09:13:51.0+01:00.

EventToNotify
required
string (EventToNotifyEnum)
Enum: "BeginMaintenance" "EndMaintenance" "Shutdown" "Initialised" "OutOfOrder" "Completed" "Abort" "SaleWakeUp" "SaleAdmin" "CustomerLanguage" "KeyPressed" "SecurityAlarm" "StopAssistance" "CardInserted" "CardRemoved" "Reject"

Type of unsolicited event the POI notifies to the Sale System.

EventDetails
string

Additional information about the event for logging. Mandatory for SaleWakeUp (transaction reference), KeyPressed (key ID), and SaleAdmin (service name).

RejectedMessage
string

Base64-encoded content of the rejected message. Mandatory when EventToNotify is Reject.

MaintenanceRequiredFlag
boolean

When true, the event requires a maintenance call or action. Default false.

CustomerLanguage
string (ISOLanguage2A) = 2 characters

Language identification per ISO 639-1 — two alpha characters (e.g. en, fr, de).

DiagnosisRequest

POIID
string

Identification of the POI Terminal to diagnose. Default is MessageHeader.POIID.

HostDiagnosisFlag
boolean

When true, the POI also checks the reachability of all connected Acquirer hosts. Default false.

AcquirerID
Array of strings

Specific Acquirer hosts to diagnose. All connected hosts are checked when absent and HostDiagnosisFlag is true.
